Subject: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Hi Jordan — great speaking with you earlier. Thanks for the time and for outlining Acme's primary evaluation goals. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC plan, success criteria, and next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please reply with any edits and confirm the kickoff window.

Summary / success criteria (what Acme wants to validate):
- Accuracy: Redwood model + prompt set should meet or exceed 85% precision on the 3 high-priority intent categories in your eval set.
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency under 350ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens).
- Throughput: sustain 40 requests/sec with <20% tail degradation during batch runs.
- Data controls: all traffic to remain within Acme's VPC sandbox; no logging to public buckets.

Evaluation plan & artifacts:
- Acme provides representative prompt set + labeled sample set (expected size: ~2k examples).
- Redwood validates against the labeled set and returns a runbook with metric breakdowns and failure cases.
- Weekly checkpoints (30 min) during trial to review metrics & triage issues.
- Final readout with exec summary and next steps (recommended model and sizing).

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week of Jun 7: Kickoff + infra access (seeding test dataset into sandbox)
- Jun 8–Jun 28: Evaluation window (3 weeks) with weekly syncs (Mon or Wed)
- Week of Jul 5: Final readout and commercial discussion

Ownership:
- Redwood (Marissa) — overall program owner, commercial and rollout questions
- Redwood (Neha, SE) — setup, weekly checkpoints, evaluation tuning
- Acme (Jordan) — provide dataset access and engineering contact for infra work

Attachments: ACME_POC_SuccessCriteria_v1.xlsx (success criteria + test plan), redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (kickoff checklist).

Next steps for Jordan: please confirm kickoff week (Jun 7–11) and provide the best engineering contact + access instructions (S3 or VPC tunnel).

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
